observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Urban sidewalk in New York City next to a street with parked cars and buildings, daytime.
observation.dancers: Mixed group of men, women, and a child; solo dancers taking turns performing in the center while others watch, cheer, and clap in a circle.
observation.formation_and_space: Circular formation with dancers gathered around an open central space where individuals take turns performing solos.
observation.posture: Upright and athletic torso, knees slightly bent with weight shifting quickly, dynamic and energetic posture.
observation.footwork: Rapid stepping, high knee raises, shuffling, quick hops, and bounces on the beat; exact heel/toe contact cannot be fully discerned due to video compression and rapid motion.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms pump, swing, and reach dynamically with the rhythm; hands are sometimes loose, clenched, or gesturing; no objects held.
observation.hips_and_torso: Torso bounces and twists with the energetic footwork; hips move naturally with the quick steps and drops.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Frequent jumps, drops to the floor/squats, and sudden level changes with occasional turns.
observation.costume_and_props: Casual streetwear including t-shirts, hoodies, track jackets, jeans, leggings, and sneakers; backpacks and water bottles on the sidewalk.
observation.cannot_infer: Exact foot placement, subtle weight shifts, and precise ankle articulation are obscured by rapid camera motion and video compression.

signature_moments.what: Dancer in red shirt performs rapid high knee raises and foot pumps in the center of the circle.
Dancer in black and white jacket executes fast bouncy footwork and drops down low.
Dancer in red shirt drops to the ground and pops back up with quick rhythmic leg extensions.
Female dancer in red plaid top drops low to the ground, kicking her legs out rapidly.
Female dancer in blue top drops to one hand on the pavement while executing fast leg sweeps.
